annotations.title: Compare online prices and net price after gift cards

description: Use this when someone asks for the lowest online price, a discount code, or what a product would cost after their gift card or card rewards ("what is the cheapest place to buy ASICS GEL-NYC online?", "I have a $50 JD Sports gift card, what would these cost me?"). Covers only products sold online by Hanes, Finish Line, JD Sports, Lane Bryant, FragranceNet, AmScope, OneHanesPlace, ECCO, Sharper Image, Bali, Greg Norman Collection, Sachin & Babi, RefrigiWear, Anine Bing, HeatAndCool, Maidenform, Premium Bandai USA, Voluspa, Big Joe, JanSport, Anastasia Beverly Hills, WonderFold, Rowe and Taylor, Cannondale, Twinkle Beds, Little Tikes, Waterdrop, Autonomous, Pure TheraPro Rx, KitchenAid, Paw.com, Cafe Britt, Amana, Caudalie, Mac of All Trades, Maytag, Lanolips, Righteous Felon, JLo Beauty, Chicsew, Fantastic Tees, ABCCANOPY, Monument Grills, Vatrer, MOJAWA, Kuli Kuli, Nature's Generator, Growth Wise, nutriEffect, Abbode, AfricanNetSponge, ALLPOWERS, Amanda Hair, Amazonliss, American Barbell, GillyGro, Autel Energy, B'alam, Babsy, Bala Rugs, BENI Rugs, Bonne et Filou, Brooklyn Delhi, Cerqular, CHORD, Cocorrina Scents, Deme by Gabriella, DEWBU, DRYWORLD, Foto&Tech, Enable Haircare, Fun Fact Co., GardePro, Hellosun, Gleeride, House of Blanks, Imperia Caviar, KNOPF New York, Meedo Designs, MimiSilk, Minteefy, Mosaic Weighted Blankets, NorthSky Supply, Nushape, Pergolux, Place of Ëlms, ROUS Hardware, Scorpify, The Powder Shampoo, Sutera, Suunto, The Dragontree, The Skin Deep, Thesupermade, Thierry Lasry, TouchBeauty, True Beauty Lashes, Vantrue, Wirsh, Kozyard, ZazzMode, Steinhafels, Walmart, Costco, Tire Rack, Priority Tire, from each store's product file. "Lowest" means among these stores, not the whole web. Returns each store's listed price, the estimated price with any confirmed discount code, and net_price: what is left to pay after the code, that store's gift card balance and card rewards, before tax and shipping. A gift card counts only at its own store. Ask for amounts only: never ask for or accept a card number, PIN or gift card code. Say that a net price is an estimate, and that sizes and stock are checked on the store's site. For stock at physical stores, use search_products.

card_rewards_percent.description: Only when the user stated it: percent back from their credit card, e.g. 2.

gift_cards.description: The gift card balances the user stated. Amounts only, never a card number, PIN or code.

store.description: The store the gift card is for.

max_price.description: Maximum listed price in US dollars.

query.description: Product words: brand and product name, e.g. "asics gel-nyc", "hanes crew socks".

store.description: Only when the user asked about one store.
